approvals.reason: Adds public generic Antelope scheme constants while preserving all existing exports.
Widens SigningRequestScheme from vsr-only to esr-or-vsr; existing vsr consumers remain valid.
Adds an optional runtimeWindow argument to wallet-author announcement; existing one-argument calls remain valid.
Adds provider-author event helpers and aliases while preserving all existing Vexanium exports.
Adds chainChanged and disconnect event validators without changing existing validator signatures.
Names existing event payload shapes with aliases while keeping their structural types unchanged.
